Class ExtraMoveState

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.controller.states.ControllerState
org.adsl.server.controller.states.ExtraMoveState
All Implemented Interfaces:
RequestVisitor<VirtualClient>
public class ExtraMoveState extends ControllerState
State that handles the optional extra card draw granted by ExtraMove buildings at end of round.

On entry it evaluates all players' end-of-round building effects. If exactly one player has an ExtraMove bonus that player becomes the current player and may pick one card from the upper row (or pass with an empty move set). If no player has the bonus the state transitions immediately to EventsState.
